categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction creation in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where `fundrawtransaction` failed to enforce the caller's `max_tx_weight` parameter when preset inputs already covered the payment amount. The PR description notes that funding previously succeeded even when resulting transactions exceeded `max_tx_weight` because coin selection was skipped and the fallback check only evaluated `MAX_STANDARD_TX_WEIGHT`.
